intentions.title: Enforce the hard multi-tenant boundary at the routing layer, before any query runs
intentions.evidence: resolve_workspace.ex authorizes membership (TenancyAuth.authorize) or an active grant before assigning :current_workspace, failing closed to 403 otherwise; scope_helpers.ex is 'the single, shared tenancy-scope extractor' that every controller/LiveView must call to turn assigns into [workspace_id:, project_id:] opts so the WHERE-clause scope is 'never hand-rolled (and silently forgotten) at a new call site'; resolve_project.ex, assign_default_scope.ex extend the same seam to flat back-compat routes.

intentions.title: Let anonymous demo/public access exist without weakening the tenant gate for everyone else
intentions.evidence: resolve_workspace.ex's allow_anonymous_default (:studio_demo vs true) options, gated per-pipeline and per BARKPARK_PUBLIC_DEMO_STUDIO config, redirect anonymous Studio HTML requests to /login while paper readers stay world-readable; public_share_guard.ex, require_share_scope.ex, require_share_edit_token.ex, public_cors.ex, public_read.ex implement scoped anonymous read/write paths (share_public/share_writer flags) that are opt-in per route and never touch the default membership gate.

intentions.title: Support multiple credential kinds (API bearer tokens, session cookies, preview JWTs, ingest tokens, webhook signatures, ticket keys, SCIM tokens) through one uniform verify-then-assign plug pattern so every surface authenticates consistently
intentions.evidence: require_token.ex / optional_token.ex verify Bearer tokens via Auth.verify_token; preview_token.ex verifies short-lived preview JWTs bound to a dataset claim (check_dataset_scope prevents cross-dataset draft escalation); require_bearer_or_session_token.ex, optional_session_token.ex, optional_user_session.ex, require_user_session.ex cover browser session auth; require_ingest_token.ex, require_media_processing_callback_token.ex, github_webhook_signature.ex, require_scim_token.ex, require_ticket_key.ex cover machine/service credentials; each halts with the same Content.Errors envelope pattern on failure.

intentions.title: Layer fine-grained authorization (admin, write-permission, workspace role, org MFA, grant-scoped reads) on top of authentication so 'who you are' and 'what you may do' stay separately composable per route
intentions.evidence: require_admin.ex, require_write_permission.ex, require_workspace_role.ex, require_principal_user.ex, require_org_mfa_enrolment.ex, require_recent_mfa.ex plugs exist as discrete pipeline steps; scope_helpers.ex's maybe_grant_scoped only sets grant_scoped when ResolveWorkspace admitted a GRANT-DERIVED caller (never a member), so Content.Query row-narrowing is additive and opt-in (airdrop-grants Layer 2).

intentions.title: Protect the API from abuse and duplicate side-effects without punishing legitimate SDK/browser traffic
intentions.evidence: rate_limit.ex implements per-token/per-IP, read/write-class, per-dataset-overridable token-bucket limiting with Retry-After; idempotency.ex dedups mutating requests by (raw_key, token_id, method, path) and replays cached sub-500 responses; ticket_rate_limit.ex applies the same discipline to the external ticket surface; cache_body_reader.ex exists to let the request body be read twice (signature verification + normal parsing) without breaking either.

intentions.title: Guarantee cross-origin requests are safe by default: dataset-scoped CORS reflection, never wildcards, fail-closed on mismatch
intentions.evidence: dataset_cors.ex resolves the owning dataset (including under the /w/:ws/p/:project prefix) and reflects access-control-allow-origin ONLY for matching entries in a per-dataset cors_origins allow-list unioned with a fixed @always_allowed_origins list; explicitly documents 'Never wildcards — fail-closed'; wildcard_match? is anchored regex to block path-injected origin spoofing; plugin_path? carve-out lets router-level plugin buckets (e.g. public_cors.ex) own their own CORS story instead of double-gating.

intentions.title: Keep legacy/back-compat surfaces (flat routes, deprecated endpoints, vendor MIME negotiation, error envelope versioning) working identically while the tenancy-scoped architecture evolves underneath them
intentions.evidence: assign_default_scope.ex assigns the seeded Default workspace/project for flat routes so old callers keep working unscoped; legacy_deprecation.ex adds deprecation headers without breaking legacy routes; accept_barkpark_vendor.ex normalizes vendor MIME Accept headers; error_envelope_negotiation.ex negotiates error envelope version so older SDK clients keep their expected error shape; api_security_headers.ex applies baseline security headers across all API responses.
